title: Applying Subheads
slide_intent: Keep support visibly subordinate while adapting its width to the headline because readers need an obvious reading order.
strategic_value: The three paired layouts can give Burger King flexible supporting copy without losing hierarchy.

practical_value: Size and position the subhead relative to its headline, noting the source’s differing measurement wording.
